questions.question: India and UK sign historic Free Trade Agreement, set to boost annual trade by $34 bn. Which UK leader was involved in signing the FTA with India?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Keir Starmer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India and UK sign historic Free Trade Agreement, set to boost annual trade by $34 bn.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India and the UK signed a landmark Free Trade Agreement (FTA)** in **2025**, aiming to boost **bilateral trade by USD 34 billion annually**.

 
 
• 
 
This is the **UK’s largest trade deal** since **Brexit** (leaving the EU in 2020).

 
 
• 
 
The agreement was signed by **Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal** and **UK’s Secretary of State for Business and Trade Jonathan Reynolds**.

 
 
• 
 
The signing followed bilateral talks between **PM Narendra Modi** and **UK PM Keir Starmer** in **London**.

 
 
• 
 
This is **India’s first major bilateral FTA with a developed country** in over **10 years**.

 
 
• 
 
**99% of Indian products** will receive **duty-free access** to the **UK market**.

 
 
• 
 
It covers key Indian exports like **leather, textiles, garments, footwear**.

 
 
• 
 
In return, the UK gets tariff cuts on items like **whisky and cars**.

 
 
• 
 
The **target is to double India-UK trade to USD 120 billion by 2030**.

 
 
• 
 
The deal also includes a **social security agreement**, helping **Indian companies save on double social security contributions** when sending employees to the UK.

 
 
• 
 
The **UK is India’s 6th-largest investor** with **USD 36 billion total investments**.

 
 
• 
 
**~1,000 Indian companies operate in the UK**, employing **over 1,00,000 people** and investing around **USD 2 billion**.

 
 
• 
 
**India’s exports to the UK rose** by **12.6% to USD 14.5 billion (2024–25)**, while **imports rose** by **2.3% to USD 8.6 billion**.

questions.question: What is the primary objective of the MoU signed between Financial Intelligence Unit-India (FIU-IND) and Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)?

options.text: To promote insurance policies in rural areas.
For effective implementation of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act.
To introduce new financial regulations for insurance companies.
To monitor and audit the banking sector's performance.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**To enhance coordination and information exchange for effective implementation of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA).**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **FIU-IND and IRDAI signed an MoU in New Delhi to enhance collaboration in implementing PMLA and associated rules.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The MoU focuses on improving coordination in areas such as intelligence sharing, AML/CFT risk assessment, and training for regulated entities.**
 
• Nodal officers and alternate nodal officers will be appointed by both parties to streamline communication and implementation.
 
• Quarterly meetings will be conducted to discuss AML/CFT trends, typologies, and cases where sanctions have been imposed.
 
• The MoU emphasizes compliance with relevant international standards to combat financial crimes effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **FIU-IND:**__ The Financial Intelligence Unit-India is responsible for receiving, processing, analyzing, and disseminating information related to financial crimes.
 
• __**IRDAI:**__ The Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India regulates and develops the insurance industry in India.
 
• __**AML/CFT:**__ Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism measures are crucial for detecting and preventing financial crimes.
 
• __**PMLA:**__ The Prevention of Money Laundering Act establishes procedures for confiscating property derived from money laundering and imposes reporting obligations on financial entities.

questions.question: With which organisation did ISRO sign an MoU for developing MATSYA-6000?

**ISRO’s Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC)** has signed an **MoU** with the **National Institute of Ocean Technology (NIOT)**.

 
 
• 
 
They will jointly develop a **submersible spherical vessel named *MATSYA-6000***.

 
 
•

questions.question: With which country has Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL) signed an MoU to jointly develop advanced Pantsir air defence systems?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Russia**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India-Russia MoU on Pantsir Air Defence Systems: Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL), an Indian state-run defence firm, has signed an MoU with Rosoboronexport, Russia’s primary weapons export agency, to jointly develop variants of the Pantsir air defence missile and gun system.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Pantsir System Capabilities: **The **Pantsir system** combines a short reaction time with missile and gun capabilities.
 
• It can engage aircraft at altitudes up to **15 km using missiles, and at altitudes of up to 3,000 meters using 30mm guns.**
 
• **Purpose of Cooperation:** The MoU aims to enhance India's air defence capabilities by developing Pantsir variants that are more suited to India's specific needs.
 
• **Strategic Context: **This agreement follows **India's $5.4-billion deal with Russia for the S-400 air defence system**, which is part of ongoing India-Russia defence cooperation. Russia supplies nearly 60% of India's military hardware.
 
• **Signed During Goa Meeting: **The agreement was signed in Goa, during a meeting of the India-Russia intergovernmental commission for defence cooperation, with key figures from both sides, including Commodore A Madhavarao (BDL) and German Kovalenko (Rosoboronexport).

 [IMAGE: https://akm-img-a-in.tosshub.com/indiatoday/images/story/202411/india-air-defence-113332464-16x9_0.jpeg?VersionId=P_mfwBvnkZbxnRJB3c_XghD3HlK.uBnB]

questions.question: Which country has India entered into a strategic partnership with for co-developing and manufacturing next-generation defence technologies?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Slovakia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **India has entered into a strategic partnership with Slovakia to co-develop and manufacture next-generation technologies for defence platforms, including Light Tanks, Future Ready Combat Vehicles (FRCVs), and Future Infantry Combat Vehicles (FICVs).**
 
• **This partnership was formalised during the official state visit of President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu, to Slovakia.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

• **The partnership aligns with India’s Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative and strengthens its position as a global hub for defence innovation and manufacturing.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• India’s Defence Manufacturing Expansion__

 
 
• India’s collaboration with Slovakia on defence manufacturing is part of a broader strategy to enhance its capabilities in advanced combat systems and promote exports in the global defence market.
